newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on lunar new year demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on lunar new year demand.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed higher on Saturday due to its increasing demand before the Chinese lunar new year on February 7, dealers said.
The local unit maintained an advantage against the greenback throughout Saturday's shortened session before ending at T$27.442 against its previous T$27.462 close.
Turnover through dealers was US$123.5 million.
"The U.S. dollar was not particularly strong overseas, so (lunar) new year demand for the Taiwan dollar began to emerge," said one dealer.
Dealers expected the rate to move within a narrow range on Monday.
